about_the_game:
“Stop the invaders, cleanse the Corruption, and Pray to the Guardian Spirits”

PRAY or DIE  is a tactical defence game about fight against greedy invaders.

Gather resources, build defense towers, and harvest Faith at the temple.

Equip weapons on your sailboat, and with help from the Guardian Sprits' power,

Defend the island in a

Survivors-like, tower defense, MOBA, action roguelite. (Seriously.)

Who do you want to believe?

  • Waka'Tua - Guardian of abundance and dread, said to have shaped nature itself. He can spear lightning straight between an enemy’s eyes, or give your sailboat a little “zap” so it can sail fast across the sea.

  • Mrrgur - The Guardian of corruption, born from pollution. He can forcibly contaminate the island to gain resources, or foul the sea to devour your enemies. At times, even the invaders succumb to the lure of Corruption.

  • Atheists- Some groups on the island believes that relying on Guardian Spirits is harmful to humans. They believes only sailboats and handmade weapons will save our island from the enemy.

  • Monster from the Deep Sea - The colossal beast slumbering in the deep sea, with massive claws and terrifying fangs. Call its name with true sincerity and it will fight at your side.

There are many other Guardian Spirits to pray.

  • Guardian blessings that scale with your Faith!!

  • Infinite replayability!

  • And more contents is planned for future updates.

So...

Which will you choose?

PRAY OR DIE

  • Some images in the game were created using generative AI.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU (e.g., Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 support (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU (e.g., Intel Core i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 750 or AMD Radeon HD 7850)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card

short_description: PRAY OR DIE is a game that combines the genres of survivor-like, tower defense, MOBA, and action roguelite. Players must build defense towers on the island, equip their sailboat with weapons, and pray to Guardian Spirits for powerful blessings to protect the island from invaders and corruption.
